estimand: mean of five per-seed AUROCs conditional on fitted models, labels and realised partitions
compound_resampling: class-stratified multinomial union-ID weights shared across all models, seeds and four regimes
cluster_resampling: unstratified multinomial fixed group-ID weights over observed test union, shared across all models, seeds and four regimes; all compounds in a group share multiplicity
invalid_policy: empty/single-class fit AUROC undefined; model mean requires all five fits valid; every family/rank analysis conditions on its complete finite draws and reports count
rank_correlation: Kendall tau-b of the same eight models in each regime, percentile intervals
multiplicity: full exploratory 28-contrast family within each grid regime and 112-contrast family across all four regimes; bootstrap max of standardised centred deviations, 95% quantile; architecture family contains four contrasts across regimes
interpretation: conditional sensitivity to observed test compounds/clusters; no training or partition resampling, independent-domain inference, causal geometry effect or post-selection confirmatory testing
